reader.requirement: At --std 85 an INITIALIZE whose REPLACING phrase names any of the five 1985 categories (ALPHABETIC, ALPHANUMERIC, NUMERIC, ALPHANUMERIC-EDITED, NUMERIC-EDITED) more than once, adjacent or separated, with a group or an elementary identifier-1, must be refused at compile time; distinct categories must be admitted.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses (COBOL0900, construct initialize-replacing-category-set-2002) a REPLACING item naming more than one category below 2002; the repeat check itself is edition-blind
refuses the 2002/2014/2023 category words (NATIONAL, BOOLEAN, pointers...) below their editions; the five 1985 words are ungated

reader.edition-search: grep of InitializeBinder.cs for DialectLevel|CobolVersion|Edition.Year|ConstructRegistry finds nothing; CheckInitializeCategoryUnique reads no edition; the gates found by grepping the COBOL0900 messages into ConstructRegistry.g.cs and VersionConformancePass.cs
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the repeat itself (COBOL0834 at 85 and 2023 alike); yes around it: the one-item multi-category form and the later category words are refused at 85 only
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses are free-format, edition-unbanded NUMERIC repeats; adjacent repeats of other categories, an elementary identifier-1 and the 85-only refusal of the multi-word item were not exercised by them

probes.printed: COBOL0834 INITIALIZE REPLACING repeats the category-name NUMERIC

probes.expected: all five distinct categories admitted; 042 / P / Q / MN with B insertion / edited 8

probes.printed: COBOL0834 NUMERIC repeated + COBOL0900 an INITIALIZE REPLACING item naming more than one category requires COBOL-2002
probes.expected: refused: the 1985 format has one category per item and the repeat breaks SR3

probes.printed: COBOL0900 INITIALIZE category-name NATIONAL requires COBOL-2002
probes.expected: refused: NATIONAL is not a 1985 category word

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.17.3 SR3  (║6.17.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR3

reader.notes: The running union in CategorySetOf feeds CheckInitializeCategoryUnique for every REPLACING item, so a repeat at any distance is COBOL0834 at 85 and 2023 alike. The diagnostic cites §2023:14.9.20.3 SR6 at --std 85 rather than the 1985 SR3 (cosmetic, not a conformance failure).

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VI.6.17.3 whole (format: one category per REPLACING item, DATA optional) and StatementValidation.cs#CheckInitializeCategoryUnique (running union, edition-blind). Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-057: r1nodata (NUMERIC BY 1 ... NUMERIC DATA BY 2, DATA omitted on one item, separated by ALPHANUMERIC) -> COBOL0834 repeats NUMERIC; r1ok2 (two identifier-1, NUMERIC and NUMERIC-EDITED distinct) -> EXIT 0 [007     5][007], B left untouched as GR2a requires. Reader's probes already cover each of the five words, adjacency, elementary identifier-1 and the 85-only multi-word item. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.17.3 SR3 'The same category cannot be repeated in a REPLACING phrase'.
